'''Tripods''' were a weapon attachment used as a mount for heavy weapons such as [[Heavy repeating blaster/Legends|heavy repeating blasters]], which included the [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
